spec.notes: EXP-A: Second 7B model for cross-scale validation. Nucleus p=0.95, d0-d5, 500 samples/depth. Feature extraction: Pythia-1.4B.

experiment_data.hypothesis: 7B cross-scale probe (Llama-3-8B): 验证 depth signal 在 Llama-3 架构上的可检测性。Nucleus p=0.95, d0-d5, 500 samples/depth。成功标准：4-class acc ≥ 60%, EDD 测定, pairwise AUC 衰减趋势与 1-1.5B 模型方向一致。
